sources.title: bloom-560m — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Can I use bloom-560m commercially? bloom-560m is distributed under the bigscience-bloom-rail-1. license. Commercial use depends on specific license terms — always verify the HuggingFace model card before production deployment. What GPU do I need to run bloom-560m? For Q4 quantization you need at least 1.8 GB VRAM.

sources.title: BLOOM (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The BigScience Large Open-science Open-access Multilingual Language Model (BLOOM) is an open-access large language model (LLM) released in 2022. [1] It was created by a volunteer-driven research effort to provide a transparently-created alternative to proprietary AI models.

sources.title: bloom-560m: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: The BLOOM RAIL 1.0 license restricts commercial use and requires attribution to the model in any deployed system. You must review the full BLOOM License Attachment A for detailed restrictions, but generally, non-commercial research and educational use are permitted while commercial applications face limitations.
